propositions: The reconcile-bridge.yml workflow does not set merge.ours.driver, causing git to silently fall back to 3-way text merge of the 18M-byte .bridge_state JSON file instead of local-wins behavior.
The merge=ours gitattribute is undefined on the CI runner because merge.ours.driver is never committed and not set in the workflow, resulting in undefined driver resolution.

The reconcile-bridge-canary.yml workflow obtains merge.ours.driver through its rebar init call and requires no changes; the reconcile-bridge.yml workflow does a bare git worktree add and never calls rebar init, making it the only affected workflow.
Setting merge.ours.driver=true in reconcile-bridge.yml is a prerequisite for the B1 blob:none filter to avoid lazily faulting large merge-base blobs during reconverge.
A diverged remote reconverge in a runner-shaped checkout must produce local-wins resolution of .bridge_state/* files without conflict markers.
